scope: The 11 exact FY2025 partner-name matches with historical fiscal-sponsor assertions in the reviewed San Francisco Foundation give-guide corpus.
method: Current status requires an official project or fiscal-sponsor source. A donation link alone confirms only that the project currently solicits donations; it does not identify the legal receiving entity unless the page says so. Historical SFF statements are never carried forward automatically.

reviews.currentFiscalSponsorName: Asian Americans for Civil Rights and Equality (AACRE)

sources.claim: A current project job page says APSC is fiscally sponsored by Asian Americans for Civil Rights and Equality (AACRE) and that staff are AACRE employees.

reviews.limitation: The current sponsor differs from SFF's historical CAA assertion. The reviewed page does not publish check-payee instructions, so the existing project donation route is not relabeled as a named payee.
